reader.decision: Approve streaming the CSV from export_contacts, on the condition that the ferngrove.web Response generator support is verified first and the gunicorn 120s limit risk is acknowledged.
reader.decision_reason: Streaming fixes the stated root cause (no bytes for the whole build) with no new components. The alternatives cost more: the timeout raise only delays the failure, and the job queue needs a queue, an email service and owners. The two stated risks are the gunicorn limit and the unverified Response API.

reconstruction.problem: export_contacts builds the whole CSV in an io.StringIO before sending any byte. For large tenants such as bluefin-logistics (412880 rows) the query takes 12s and the build takes 77s more. edge-lb has an idle_timeout_seconds of 30 and sees no bytes.
reconstruction.what_breaks: edge-lb closes the connection and returns 504 (reason=edge-lb-idle-timeout) at second 30. export_contacts finishes at about second 90 but the connection is gone, so the user gets nothing. This was logged twice for bluefin-logistics on 2026-10-27, at 09:12 and 14:02. Small tenants such as harrow-dental (3120 rows) return 200 in 1s.
reconstruction.fix: Change export_contacts in app/exports.py to return Response(generator, content_type='text/csv'). The generator yields the header at once, then runs db.query (unchanged), then yields batches of CSV lines. Each byte restarts the edge-lb idle timer, so no gap reaches 30s.
reconstruction.cost: No new component. Total time is still about 90s, so the gunicorn sync worker (timeout = 120) is busy that whole time. A tenant about 30% larger than bluefin-logistics would hit the 120s limit and lose its worker. It is also unverified that ferngrove.web's Response accepts a generator, because that code is not in the repository.

follow_up_questions: Does ferngrove.web's Response accept a generator and stream it, and can someone confirm this, since that code is not in the repo?

Does the gunicorn worker timeout of 120s with the sync worker count only time with no activity, or total request time, when the response is streamed? If it counts total request time, how soon will the largest tenants reach 120s?
reader.closing_answer: I approve streaming the CSV from export_contacts, not the alternatives. Before merging, I want the Response generator support confirmed. I also want a plan for the gunicorn 120s limit, because tenants about 30% larger than bluefin-logistics will hit it.
